name: moh731V2023Moh729bPrepBase
description: MOH 729B F-MAPS, PrEP: the MOH 731 PrEP visits in the reporting month (moh731V2023PrepVisitsBase -- its facility scope, one visit per client per day, Follow-ups unless PrEP was not prescribed, each client's latest Initial where PrEP was prescribed), with the form's PrEP regimen code: CAB-LA -> PRP1E (Cabotegravir), Dapivirine ring -> PRP1D, oral PrEP by the drug prescribed (9774): EMTRICITABINE AND TENOFOVIR 6180 -> PRP1A (TDF + FTC), LAMIVUDINE AND TENOFOVIR 1400 -> PRP1B (TDF + 3TC), Lenacapavir -> PRP1F (added to the form's codes), anything else (oral with no drug recorded) -> PRP1X. One row per visit, oldest first: the service keeps each client's latest visit of the month and drops those discontinued, leaving the current active PrEP clients.

expressionOptions.expression: (SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = v.patient_id AND pi.identifier_type = 44 AND pi.voided = 0 ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)

CASE WHEN v.visit = 'Initial' THEN CASE WHEN v.transfer_in = 'Yes' THEN 'Continuing' ELSE 'New' END WHEN v.prep_status IN ('CONTINUE REGIMEN', 'CHANGE REGIMEN') THEN 'Continuing' WHEN v.prep_status = 'DRUG RESTART' THEN 'Restart' WHEN v.prep_status IN ('DISCONTINUE', 'TRANSFER OUT') THEN 'Discontinued' END

CASE WHEN v.prep_type = 'CAB-LA' THEN 'Cabotegravir' WHEN v.prep_type = 'Dapivirine ring' THEN 'Dapivirine ring' WHEN v.prep_type = 'Lenacapavir' THEN 'Lenacapavir' WHEN v.prep_type = 'Oral' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM amrs.obs o WHERE o.encounter_id = v.encounter_id AND o.concept_id = 9774 AND o.value_coded = 6180 AND o.voided = 0) THEN 'TDF + FTC' WHEN v.prep_type = 'Oral' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM amrs.obs o WHERE o.encounter_id = v.encounter_id AND o.concept_id = 9774 AND o.value_coded = 1400 AND o.voided = 0) THEN 'TDF + 3TC' ELSE COALESCE(v.regimen, 'Not recorded') END

CASE WHEN v.prep_type = 'CAB-LA' THEN 'PRP1E' WHEN v.prep_type = 'Dapivirine ring' THEN 'PRP1D' WHEN v.prep_type = 'Lenacapavir' THEN 'PRP1F' WHEN v.prep_type = 'Oral' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM amrs.obs o WHERE o.encounter_id = v.encounter_id AND o.concept_id = 9774 AND o.value_coded = 6180 AND o.voided = 0) THEN 'PRP1A' WHEN v.prep_type = 'Oral' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM amrs.obs o WHERE o.encounter_id = v.encounter_id AND o.concept_id = 9774 AND o.value_coded = 1400 AND o.voided = 0) THEN 'PRP1B' ELSE 'PRP1X' END
